title: Keep Network city autocomplete aligned with its current query
detail: Revalidated current main and merged backlog: SCAN-921 already repairs DirectorySearch cancellation; the distinct CircleLocationSearch on /network still published responses after its effect was aborted. A slow old city request overwrote the latest suggestions, clearing the input left loading true if the old request never settled, and provider/JSON rejection escaped the async timeout without stopping the spinner. Guard state publication and finalization with the effect abort signal, stop loading for short/empty input, and recover quietly from provider rejection consistently with the existing optional-suggestion contract. Three behavioral jsdom regressions failed on the old code (plus one unhandled rejection); after the fix 249 tests in 26 search/geocode/navigation suites passed and changed-file lint passed. The fourth regression preserves active filters and coordinate rounding when choosing a city. Mocked provider responses only; no external geocoding calls, geolocation prompts, production data changes, new dependencies, or token/style changes. Probe-cost correction on 2026-10-23: the prior ledger command reran the full test runner (node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --cache=false --fsModuleCachePath .next/cache/audit-vitest --maxWorkers=2 components/circles/circle-location-search.test.tsx components/ui/directory-search.test.tsx components/search/search-overlay.test.tsx). Keep those comprehensive behavior tests in normal CI; the ledger now executes the actual code/fixture consequence directly without a nested runner. No assertion or application gate is waived.

verify.note: Deferred responses that ignore abort cannot replace the latest city, short input stops loading without waiting for the old request, rejected provider work permits recovery, and selecting a city preserves current filters. Normal CI retains the fuller test suites; this direct probe keeps the per-row guard bounded.
